* feat: Implement event buffering and storage for print and Bluetooth connect events

- Created separate tables in ClickHouse for print_events and bluetooth_connect_events with optimized schemas.
- Implemented graceful shutdown for event buffering to prevent data loss.
- Refactored existing code to accommodate new event types and improve maintainability.
